```{r}
parse_abi_hierarchy <-
  function(abi){
    abi_list <- rjson::fromJSON(file = abi)$msg[[1]]
    tree <- recursive_build_tree(abi_list)
  }

recursive_build_tree <- function(tree_list){
  children_list <- tree_list$children
  node_list <- tree_list[names(tree_list) != "children"]
  
  node <- do.call(Node$new, node_list)
  
  if(is.null(children_list) || length(children_list) == 0){
    return(node)
  } else {
    lapply(children_list, function(cl){
      child_node <- recursive_build_tree(cl)
      node$AddChildNode(child_node)
      
      NULL
    })
    
    return(node)
  }
}

scale_colour_posneg_alpha <- function(name = waiver(), ..., aesthetic="colour", low=NULL, high=NULL, threshold=1, lowalpha=0.3) {
  if (is.null(low))
    low <- 0
  if (is.null(high))
    high <- max(breaks)
  continuous_scale(aesthetic, name=name, 
                   palette = MRIcrotome:::testPalette2(c("turquoise1", 
                                                      "blue", 
                                                      "white", 
                                                      "red", 
                                                      "yellow"),
                                          values = scales::rescale(c(-high, -0.000001, 0, 0.000001, high)), 
                                          low, 
                                          high),
                   breaks = c(-high, -low, low, high),
                   limits=c(-high, high),
                   oob=scales::squish, 
                   na.value="transparent",
                   guide="colourbar", ...)
}
```

```{r}
outfile_prefix <- "figure_S6"
output_dir <- file.path("outputs", outfile_prefix)
if (!(dir.exists(output_dir))) {dir.create(path = output_dir, recursive = TRUE)}
```

```{r}
nlinFile <- file.path(PROJECTPATH, "data/mouse/registration/reference_files/scanbase_second_level-nlin-3.mnc")
labelFile <- file.path(PROJECTPATH, "data/mouse/registration/reference_files/scanbase_second_level-nlin-3_labels.mnc")

nlin <- mincArray(mincGetVolume(nlinFile))
labels <- mincArray(mincGetVolume(labelFile))


defs <- file.path(PROJECTPATH, "data/mouse/registration/reference_files/DSURQE_40micron_R_mapping.csv")
tree_file <- file.path(PROJECTPATH, "data/mouse/registration/reference_files/DSURQE_tree.json")

hdefs <- parse_abi_hierarchy(abi = tree_file)

sliceList <- map(seq(50, 350, length.out=8), ~ c(round(.x), 2))
sliceList[[length(sliceList)+1]] <- c(140,1)
sliceOffset <- 5

sl <- MRIcrotome(nlin, labels, hdefs, sliceList, assembleDir = "Y", sliceOffset = sliceOffset)
```

```{r}
peaks <- read_csv("resources/MICe_peaks_new_cluster_labs.csv", 
                  show_col_types = FALSE)


peaks2 <- peaks %>% 
  rowwise() %>% 
  mutate(voxel = list(mincConvertWorldToVoxel(nlinFile, x, y, z)),
         sliceDist = list(pointToSlicesDistance(sliceList, voxel)),
         keepSlice = list(which(abs(sliceDist) < 21))) %>% 
  unnest_longer(keepSlice) %>% 
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(point = list(convertPointToMRIcrotome(voxel, sl, keepSlice))) %>%
  unnest_wider(point, names_sep = "p")

defs2 <- read_csv(defs, show_col_types = FALSE) %>% 
  select(Structure, ABI)

peaks2 <- peaks2 %>% 
  mutate(bilatstructure = str_remove_all(structure, "\\s*left\\s*|\\s*right\\s*")) %>% 
  left_join(defs2, by = c("bilatstructure" = "Structure")) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(structure)) %>%
  rowwise() %>% 
  mutate(hierarchy = list(FindNode(hdefs, ABI)), 
         l2 = hierarchy$path[2],
         l3 = hierarchy$path[3],
         l4 = hierarchy$path[4],
         l5 = hierarchy$path[5],
         lb = ifelse(l4 == "Cerebral cortex", hierarchy$path[6], l4))

```

```{r}
motifs <- read_csv("resources/MICe_motifs_new_cluster_labs.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

motif_lvls <- c("transcription", "MAPK-WNT", "synaptic-immune")
motif_labels <- c("Transcription", "MAPK-WNT", "Synaptic-Immune")

df_ss <- left_join(peaks2, motifs, by="cluster_id") %>% 
               filter(nk.x > 6) %>% 
               filter(!is.na(motif) & motif != "androgen") %>% 
  mutate(motif_label = case_when(motif == "transcription" ~ "Transcription",
                                 motif == "MAPK-WNT" ~ "MAPK-WNT",
                                 motif == "synaptic-immune" ~ "Synaptic-Immune"),
         motif_label = factor(motif_label, levels = motif_labels)) %>% 
  select(x = pointpx, y = pointpy, peak, motif, motif_label)

plt_ss <- MRIcroscope(sl) %>%
  add_anatomy() +
  geom_point(data = df_ss,
             aes(x = x, y = y, colour = peak)) +
  scale_colour_posneg_alpha(low = 0.2, high = 1) +
  geom_sf(data = sl$data, fill = NA) + 
  facet_wrap(~motif_label, ncol = 1) +
  coord_sf(xlim = c(100, 1785)) + 
  labs(colour = "Effect size") +
  theme(legend.title = element_text(size = 7),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 6),
        legend.margin = margin())

plt_ss_grob <- ggplotGrob(plt_ss)

plt_ss
```

```{r}
peakMotifData <- peaks2 %>% 
  left_join(motifs, by = "cluster_id") %>% 
  filter(nk.x > 6 & !is.na(lb)) %>% 
  group_by(lb, motif) %>% 
  summarise(l2= first(l2), 
            n=n(), 
            propgt0 = mean(peak > 0), 
            peak = mean(peak))  %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  filter(l2 == "Basic cell groups and regions") %>% 
  filter(!is.na(motif) & motif != "androgen") %>% 
  mutate(lb = fct_relevel(lb, 
                          "Cerebellar cortex",
                          "Hindbrain", "Interbrain", "Midbrain",
                          "Cerebral nuclei",
                          "Claustrum", "Isocortex", "Hippocampal formation", "Olfactory areas")) %>%
  group_by(lb) %>% 
  mutate(totaln = max(n), 
         percMax = (n/totaln)*100) %>% 
  ungroup()

peakMotifData %>% 
  select(motif, lb, n, totaln, percMax)
```

```{r}
df_peaks_plt <- peakMotifData %>% 
  mutate(motif = factor(motif, levels = motif_lvls))


motif_palette <- c("MAPK-WNT" = "springgreen4", 
                   "synaptic-immune" = "seagreen2",
                   "transcription" = "darkorchid1")

plt_peaks <- ggplot(df_peaks_plt) + 
  aes(y = lb, x = peak, colour = motif) + 
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0) +
  geom_point(aes(size = percMax)) + 
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-2, 2)) + 
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(-2, 2, by = 1),
                     expand = expansion(add = 0.3)) + 
  scale_size_area("Percent of max n peaks", max_size = 5) + 
  scale_colour_manual(values = motif_palette, labels = motif_labels) + 
  labs(x = "Mean Peak Effect Size",
       y = NULL,
       col = "Molecular group") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.title = element_text(size = 7),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 6),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 7),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 6, margin = margin()),
        # legend.background = element_rect(color = "black"),
        # legend.key = element_rect(color = "black"),
        legend.key.size = unit(18, "bigpts"),
        legend.margin = margin())

plt_peaks_grob <- ggplotGrob(plt_peaks)



panel_A_title <- gTree(children = gList(
  textGrob(
    label = "A", 
    x = unit(3, "bigpts"), 
    just = "left", gp = gpar(fontsize = 10, fontface = "bold")
  ),
  textGrob(
    label = "Neuroanatomy of molecular group centroids for K > 6", 
    x = unit(15, "bigpts"), 
    just = "left", gp = gpar(fontsize = 8)
  )))

panel_B_title <- gTree(children = gList(
  textGrob(
    label = "B", 
    x = unit(3, "bigpts"), 
    just = "left", gp = gpar(fontsize = 10, fontface = "bold")
  ),
  textGrob(
    label = "Molecular group centroid effect size peaks for K > 6", 
    x = unit(15, "bigpts"), 
    just = "left", gp = gpar(fontsize = 8)
  )))



fig_width <- 7.25*72

ss_width <- fig_width
ss_height <- ss_width/2.42

peaks_width <- fig_width - ss_width

fig_widths <- fig_width
fig_heights <- c(20, 180, 20, ss_height)


fig_layout <- cbind(1:4)

fig_grob <- arrangeGrob(panel_A_title,
                        plt_peaks_grob,
                        panel_B_title,
                        plt_ss_grob, 
                        layout_matrix = fig_layout,
                        widths = unit(fig_widths, "bigpts"),
                        heights = unit(fig_heights, "bigpts"))

fig_height_pt <- sum(fig_heights)
fig_width_pt <- sum(fig_widths)

fig_height_in <- fig_height_pt/72
fig_width_in <- fig_width_pt/72

outfile <- paste0(outfile_prefix, ".pdf")
outfile <- file.path(output_dir, outfile)
pdf(file = outfile,
    width = unit(fig_width_in, "in"),
    height = unit(fig_height_in, "in"))
grid.draw(fig_grob)
invisible(dev.off())
```
